Wow, this makes it a lot easier to move forward.Thank you, Hal.

Michael

Hi Michael,

Good to hear, and thanks for coming back to tell me. Your new order is Shop···· and it's in front of me: the Hammer Thor P2, the overclocking option, and the Harlo OS diagnostics with the 3 month RMA, which came through at no charge.

It's paid in full at $460.88, with your $324.48 credit applied in full and $136.40 on PayPal. Nothing is outstanding on it.

The T. P2 ships November 3. It's a pre-order, so the warehouse is waiting on that batch to arrive before it picks, and you can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Given your history with us, I've put this order on my own list. If that date moves at all, you'll hear it from me rather than finding out by silence, and you'll get the tracking the moment it's labelled.

If you want a hand with pool setup when it lands, Hal and JD are in the Discord daily.

Best regards,
Sarah H.
Thank you, Sarah.Michael S. from the all new AOL app for iOS

Hi Michael,

Any time. You are all set, nothing more needed from you on this one. I will be in touch as the Thor P2 gets close to shipping, and sooner if anything moves.

It has been a genuine pleasure sorting this out with you, and thank you for your patience through the return. If you were happy with how we handled it, a few words on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

And if you are not in there already, you are very welcome in our Discord for new product news and hands on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Best regards,
Sarah H.
